name: gamlike
expr: [nL_basic, av] = gamlike([2, 1], x); nL_a0 = gamlike([0, 1], x); nL_b0 = gamlike([2, 0], x);
comment: Sig: [nL, AVAR] = gamlike([a b], x). NLL for Gamma(a, b). AVAR is the 2×2 inverse observed-Fisher info matrix at [a, b], computed via central-difference Hessian (no in-tree trigamma). Edge: invalid params (a<=0 or b<=0) => NaN. tol=1e-7 reflects FD precision (~5e-8 absolute on basic case).
